impact: Money is rotating away from AI-heavy markets toward Europe ahead of Nvidia; that is a mild headwind for AI names like NBIS and MU and neutral for C and NOK.
summary: The Stoxx 600 edged up 0.09% to 664.76 early Monday, helped by low AI exposure and a Morgan Stanley upgrade of European equities to overweight. Chip names lagged, with Infineon down 2.3% and Aixtron 1.9%, and Siemens Energy fell 1.6%.
title: European stocks steady, Stoxx 600 up 0.1% as chip names slip
